Skill.constraints[0]: Treat this skill as CLI-first automation.
Skill.constraints[1]: Do not pivot to `@playwright/test` unless the user explicitly asks for test files.
Skill.constraints[2]: Before proposing commands, check whether `npx` is available (the wrapper depends on it).
Skill.constraints[3]: Once `npx` is present, proceed with the wrapper script. A global install of `playwright-cli` is optional.
Skill.constraints[4]: Prefer the bundled wrapper script so the CLI works even when it is not globally installed.
Skill.constraints[5]: Prefer the wrapper unless the repository already standardizes on a global install.
Skill.constraints[6]: Use the wrapper script unless the CLI is already installed globally:
Skill.constraints[7]: Default to CLI commands and workflows, not Playwright test specs.
Skill.constraints[8]: Use the wrapper script and snapshot often.
Skill.constraints[9]: In this repo, run commands from `output/playwright/<label>/` to keep artifacts contained.
Skill.constraints[10]: If an element ref fails, run `pwcli snapshot` again and retry.
Skill.constraints[11]: If the page looks wrong, re-open with `--headed` and resize the window.
Skill.constraints[12]: By default, the CLI reads `playwright-cli.json` from the current directory. Use `--config` to point at a specific file.
